body: Convert the subject in the uploaded photo into a realistic painted collectible figure displayed on a desk. Preserve distinctive facial features, outfit and pose while making the materials clearly miniature resin and plastic. Place it on a clear circular stand, with a matching illustrated retail box nearby and a monitor showing the same figure as a modeling wireframe. Use natural desktop lighting.
